mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) consistently predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as stronger labor market conditions support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where PAYEMS shows a positive month-over-month change, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.25% (FEDFUNDS < 0.25), the Federal Reserve's accommodative monetary policy compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS < 0.25, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) and a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.5%) signals a strong economic recovery phase, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings and reduced risk premiums.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both FEDFUNDS < 0.25 and UNRATE < 5.5, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-pandemic economic recovery phase, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer confidence and increased construction activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months during the post-pandemic recovery phase when HOUST is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1050 thousand units (HOUST > 1050), it signals robust demand for new homes and associated economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST > 1050, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) consistently indicates expanding manufacturing output and supply chain strength, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when INDPRO shows a positive month-over-month change, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1050 thousand units and industrial production (INDPRO) is above 105, it signals a synchronized expansion in both the housing market and manufacturing sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST > 1050 and INDPRO > 105, or the interaction term is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: In a low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL year-over-year change < 2.5%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative monetary policy, supporting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months during the low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL YoY < 2.5%), or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
